name: header

examples.instructions: Below 48em (768px), initialize the header and activate Menu. The navigation opens as a drawer over a page overlay; USWDS moves focus to Close, keeps Tab and Shift+Tab inside the drawer, and hides the rest of the page except the Menu button from assistive technology until Close, the overlay, a navigation link, or Escape closes it.

Initialize the header and activate a submenu button such as Services, Licenses and permits, or Agencies. Its aria-expanded becomes true and its dropdown or mega menu opens; Escape, activating another submenu button, clicking outside, or moving focus out of the navigation closes it.

description: A Colorado-themed USWDS basic header with a replaceable site logo, optional search and language controls, a labelled primary navigation with optional dropdowns and mega menus, and the USWDS mobile navigation drawer below 48em.
